# Neuroba

> Neuroba pioneers neurotechnology for direct human consciousness connection through brain-computer interfaces and quantum communication.

Neuroba is a neurotechnology startup developing the Shared Consciousness Network, enabling mind-to-mind communication and collective intelligence through advanced BCIs, quantum entanglement communication, and ethical AI systems. The platform transforms how humans collaborate, learn, and connect at a consciousness level.

## Key Topics

- Brain-Computer Interfaces (BCIs)
- Quantum Communication
- Shared Consciousness Network
- Collective Consciousness
- Neurotechnology
- Mind-to-Mind Communication
- Ethical Artificial Intelligence
- Consciousness Networking
- Quantum Entanglement Communication
- Collective Intelligence
- Neural Technology

- Collective Dreaming
- Human Connection
